title: MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - SOTO-MARTINEZ) relative to funding for the Sunland Blvd and Johanna Signal Project.
text:
[Council File 26-0011-S20; CD 7]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - SOTO-MARTINEZ) relative to funding for the Sunland Blvd and Johanna Signal Project.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $437,000 in the Council District 7 portion of the Street Furniture Revenue Fund No. 43D/50 to the Department of Transportation Fund No. 840, Department 94, Account No. 94VE25, (Sunland Blvd at Johanna Ave Improvement) for the Sunland Blvd and Johanna Signal Project.
AUTHORIZE the Department of Transportation to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
summary: Transfers $437,000 of Council District 7 street furniture funds to the Department of Transportation for a traffic signal project at Sunland Boulevard and Johanna Avenue.

locations.text: Sunland Blvd & Johanna Ave, Los Angeles, CA
